content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Bakersfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific eligibility thresholds for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, high school diploma, or equivalent. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can clarify which requirements apply to you before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. You'll attend interactive sessions designed to cover the full PMBOK® Guide framework and exam domains. Our Bakersfield-based instructors deliver real-world scenarios relevant to oil, energy, and construction project environments where many local professionals work.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the required contact hours, submit your official PMI application and pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the online submission process and answer questions about documentation. PMI typically processes applications within two business weeks.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to reinforce core competencies. Schedule your computer-based exam at a local Pearson testing center in Bakersfield. Our instructors remain available to clarify challenging topics before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you'll earn the PMP® credential valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continued learning, volunteer work, or additional training. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible workshops and webinars to support your ongoing professional development and career advancement.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
